judgment.reason: Premise p8 (‘exactly one of cobalt scarf and scarlet hat’) was mistranslated using the cobalt-badge predicate (p6) instead of the cobalt-scarf predicate (p9). Using the correct predicates, the XOR chain (p21,p19,p10,p27,p24,p8) actually forces Ada's cobalt scarf to be true and thus her scarlet hat to be false, so the query 'not (scarlet hat)' follows as True — the opposite of the certified result, which rests on the mistranslated p8.
